# Devbarat

Devbarat Prasad Patel is a software builder, educator, and creator from Birgunj, Nepal.

## Pages

- [Home](https://devbarat.com.np/): Practical software, product thinking, frontend work, AI workflows, and business automation.
- [About](https://devbarat.com.np/about): Background, working style, and approach to building useful software.
- [Education](https://devbarat.com.np/education): Notes about learning by building and sharing practical lessons.
- [Projects](https://devbarat.com.np/projects): Work across commerce, booking systems, supplier operations, CRM, and AI media workflows.
- [Contact](https://devbarat.com.np/contact): Start a conversation about a software or automation project.
